intro: Section 23.8 covers behavior therapy: its history and learning principles, systematic desensitization, graded exposure, flooding, participant modeling, exposure in virtual reality, assertiveness and social skills training, daily monitoring of rituals, aversion therapy, EMDR, positive reinforcement, behavioral activation and results. A dashed box adds current PTSD guideline positions on EMDR and exposure.
objectives: Trace the history of behavior therapy and its learning principles (Pavlov, Skinner, Wolpe).
Carry out the steps of systematic desensitization and know its indications.
Compare graded exposure, flooding and participant modeling.
Describe assertiveness, social skills training, aversion therapy and EMDR.
Explain positive reinforcement, token economies and behavioral activation, and summarize results.
